configs.config/icheme-common.toml:
#Log process-equipment calculation inputs, results, diagnostics, timing, and outputs.
enableCalculationLogging = true

[solver]
	#Shared CPU solve workers. 0 allocates by demand within automaticWorkerLimit and available processors - 2; 1-32 sets a fixed limit.
	#Applied when the server starts. Performance qualification uses an explicit value of 2.
	# Default: 0
	# Range: 0 ~ 32
	workers = 0
	#Maximum shared CPU workers in automatic mode; idle capacity scales down with demand.
	# Default: 12
	# Range: 1 ~ 32
	automaticWorkerLimit = 12
	#Maximum admitted process solves waiting for a worker.
	# Default: 8
	# Range: 1 ~ 32
	readyQueueCapacity = 8
	#Cooperative wall-clock deadline for one process solve, in milliseconds; iterative kernels poll it.
	# Default: 45000
	# Range: 100 ~ 60000
	deadlineMilliseconds = 45000
	#Server-stop grace period before interrupting solver workers, in milliseconds.
	# Default: 1000
	# Range: 0 ~ 10000
	gracefulShutdownMilliseconds = 1000
	#Bounded wait after solver-worker interruption, in milliseconds.
	# Default: 1000
	# Range: 0 ~ 10000
	forcedShutdownMilliseconds = 1000

[fluid]
	#Liquid phases above this dynamic viscosity (Pa.s) cannot be transported. Applied at server start.
	# Default: 100.0
	# Range: 1.0E-6 ~ 1.0E12
	solidViscosityPascalSeconds = 100.0
	#Ignore smaller particle volume fractions for blockage only; all mass and size records remain conserved. 0 disables masking.
	# Default: 1.0E-8
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 0.01
	solidTraceVolumeFraction = 1.0E-8
	#Gameplay multiplier applied to particle settling speed for minimum liquid transport velocity.
	# Default: 10.0
	# Range: 0.01 ~ 10000.0
	solidSuspensionMultiplier = 10.0
	#Retained solid volume capacity of an in-line filter (m3). Existing captured material is preserved when this changes.
	# Default: 0.01
	# Range: 1.0E-9 ~ 1000.0
	filterSolidCapacityCubicMetres = 0.01
	#Clean in-line filter resistance at 1 mPa.s, in Pa.s/m3.
	# Default: 1000000.0
	# Range: 1.0 ~ 1.0E15
	filterCleanResistance = 1000000.0
	#Starting hydraulic cadence for newly created islands. Existing saved clocks retain their cadence; adaptation uses 1-20 s.
	# Default: 5
	# Range: 1 ~ 20
	initialIntervalSeconds = 5
	#Adapt island cadence to measured CPU load. Disable for reproducible fixed-cadence qualification; saved simulation debt is retained.
	adaptiveCadence = true
	#Hard worker budget per island interval: a solve past it counts as failed, and the adaptive cadence reads 75% of it as its slow-solve threshold. Applied on server start.
	# Default: 2000
	# Range: 100 ~ 60000
	wallBudgetMilliseconds = 2000
	#Maximum bulk pipe velocity in m/s, also limited by the current fluid's acoustic bound. Caps mass transfer inside the coupled equations; does not set temperature. Captured on server start.
	# Default: 100.0
	# Range: 0.01 ~ 100000.0
	maximumVelocityMetresPerSecond = 100.0
	#Volume of newly placed reservoirs in cubic metres. Applied on server start.
	# Default: 1.0
	# Range: 0.001 ~ 1000.0
	reservoirVolumeCubicMetres = 1.0
	#Trace cutoff as a mole fraction for the hydraulic network's Newton unknowns, not a feed filter.
	#A component whose seed mole fraction is below this in one hydrocarbon phase and at or above it
	#in the other keeps a single unknown - its component total, in the phase it is actually in - and
	#loses its equilibrium row; the omitted phase is held at exactly zero, so every component total,
	#transport split and conservation audit stays exact. The converged fugacity coefficients put a
	#component back into both phases as soon as its equilibrium fraction reaches ten times this value.
	#0 is the exact off switch: the identical numerical path, not a very small cutoff.
	#Applied on server start.
	# Default: 1.0E-6
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0E-5
	fluidTraceCutoffMoleFraction = 1.0E-6
	#Report held fluid intervals in chat, at most once per second; full details remain in the server log.
	debugChat = false
	#Certify islands whose interval map is stationary and advance them without solving, by replaying the last solved interval
	#(the identity when nothing moved). Off disables certificates; islands solve every interval. Captured on server start.
	restDetection = true
	#Largest change between two consecutive intervals that still counts as stationary: per node and component,
	#relative to that inventory; per node energy, relative to its thermal scale; per pipe, relative to the island's largest flow;
	#and the largest per-interval drift of a node's temperature or pressure. 0 admits only intervals that repeat exactly.
	#The default 1e-7 lets through-flow islands whose holdup drifts by a few 1e-7 per interval certify; their replay stays within the inventory budget. Captured on server start.
	# Default: 1.0E-7
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0E-6
	certificateStationaryTolerance = 1.0E-7
	#Largest relative inventory change a certificate may extrapolate before one interval is solved again. Captured on server start.
	# Default: 1.0E-6
	# Range: 1.0E-12 ~ 0.001
	certificateInventoryBudget = 1.0E-6
	#Most intervals one certificate of an island on which something moves may replay; 17280 is one game day at a 5 s cadence. Captured on server start.
	# Default: 17280
	# Range: 1 ~ 1000000
	certificateMaximumIntervals = 17280
	#Consecutive stationary solved intervals before an island certifies, and again after a property hold. Captured on server start.
	# Default: 2
	# Range: 1 ~ 10
	restConfirmIntervals = 2
	#Solve a certified island on which nothing moves (the identity map) again after this many simulated seconds; 0 means never. Captured on server start.
	# Default: 0
	# Range: 0 ~ 86400
	restRecheckSeconds = 0

[columnV3]
	#LNN_FIRST tries the bundled learned seed, then the current initializer as backup.
	#LNN_ONLY never invokes current initialization. CURRENT_ONLY bypasses the model.
	#One learned model ships: the regrouped-basis Transformer regrouped-seed-17041-epoch-160
	#(data/icheme/neural/registry.json). There is no model selection.
	#All routes retain physical acceptance checks. Captured at request admission.
	#Allowed Values: LNN_FIRST, LNN_ONLY, CURRENT_ONLY
	initializerMode = "LNN_FIRST"
	#Learned seeds only: AUTO and PREDICTED_WET retain the model's validated wet mask.
	#DRY_START clears the initial wet set; subsequent water physics and wet correction remain enabled.
	#Allowed Values: AUTO, DRY_START, PREDICTED_WET
	lnnWetStartMode = "AUTO"
	#Maximum Newton iterations per learned correction pass; all passes also share the LNN time budget.
	# Default: 16
	# Range: 1 ~ 128
	lnnMaxCorrectionIterations = 16
	#Shared inference/correction allowance in milliseconds; never extends the overall solve deadline.
	# Default: 2000
	# Range: 1 ~ 60000
	lnnBudgetMilliseconds = 2000
	#V3 stage-level trace cutoff in mol% (not a feed filter).
	#Components below this cutoff in every testable phase at a stage may be structurally removed there.
	#Feed trays are retained; removed inflows form an audited molar defect. Failed truncated solves retry untruncated.
	#0 is the exact off switch. Default remains 0 pending accuracy/performance evaluation.
	#Captured at admission; config reloads do not change in-flight solves.
	# Default: 0.0
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0
	stageTraceCutoffMolPercent = 0.0
	#V3 convergence closure in percent: how tightly every residual row must close.
	#A component balance closes to this fraction of its own tray throughput, equilibrium to this
	#difference in log composition, and each tray's energy to this fraction of a reference flow.
	#The acceptance audit's equilibrium, condenser-split and energy-closure limits move with it.
	#0 is the exact off switch and keeps the frozen 1e-8 closure; 0.1 is the loosest admitted.
	#A nonzero value changes the accepted state, so it is part of the result digest and label.
	#Captured at admission; config reloads do not change in-flight solves.
	# Default: 0.0
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 0.1
	columnV3ConvergenceClosurePercent = 0.0
	#Request-only liquid-supply screen: reject a specification whose authored side draws withdraw
	#at least this fraction of the liquid that reflux, feed and authored pumparound condensation
	#can deliver to their trays. No flash and no thermodynamics; a rejected request fails in
	#microseconds with INFEASIBLE_SPECIFICATION instead of seconds of Newton work.
	#0.30 is calibrated, not proved: over 474 independently generated solvable requests the worst
	#reached 0.2176, and 0.30 typed 16 of 405 and 11 of 252 never-solved requests with no false
	#positive. Do not lower it below 0.2176 without re-measuring. A ratio at or above 1 is
	#physically necessary and is always rejected, whatever this value is.
	#0 disables the calibrated tier and leaves only that necessary rejection, which is what a
	#research probe on the draw-wall specifications wants.
	#Captured at admission; config reloads do not change in-flight solves.
	# Default: 0.3
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0
	columnV3LiquidSupplyScreenRatio = 0.3

[equipment]
	#Primary colour of new equipment designs as #RRGGBB: shell, heads, cladding and unit casings.
	#Built-in: RAL 9006 white aluminium. The constructor's Paint page changes it per design.
	primaryColour = "#A1A1A0"
	#Secondary colour of new equipment designs as #RRGGBB: skirts, saddles and steelwork.
	#Built-in: RAL 7031 blue grey.
	secondaryColour = "#5B686D"
	#Metallic sheen of round equipment bodies, 0 to 0.4: a fixed highlight baked over their shade (0: none).
	#It is a vertex colour, so it costs nothing per frame and shows under Sodium and Iris shader packs too.
	#A round body seen from the north or south shows a bright band, from the east or west bright rims.
	#Read when the models are baked: restart the client or reload resources (F3+T) after a change.
	# Default: 0.2
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 0.4
	metallicSheen = 0.2
